column1: # The Internals Reference's PDF, re-frozen at wave LD4 (2026-08-19) and READ before
# freezing. Rendered from the same Texinfo pass as the HTML.
# ⚠ PAGES MOVED 1,349 -> 1,266, FOR TWO KNOWN REASONS AT ONCE, and that is one reason too
# many to separate after the fact:
#   (a) the page became A4 (595 x 842) where wave LD1 left it at the package default of
#       US Letter (612 x 792) -- taller pages, fewer of them; and
#   (b) the packages' latent line-metrics fix arrived in the same pin bump to 1.0.232.110.
# Both were expected (the pair's own changes document predicted page counts would move).
# The page SIZE is now frozen in this file precisely so the NEXT move has one explanation:
# if the size rows are unchanged and PAGES moves, the layout changed.
# PDF_WARNINGS 0 and PDF_ITEMS 0: this manual's entire non-ASCII inventory is seven
# Latin-1 code points, all covered. It carries no snippets, so SVG_RASTER_SCALE and
# KEEP_UNCOVERED are recorded here as the settings the render RAN with rather than as
# anything this manual exercises.
# ⚠ KEEP_UNCOVERED WENT false -> true AT WAVE LD5 (decision D56, ruled), AND PAGES DID NOT
# MOVE. That pairing is the point: the flag is the only row that changed, so the re-freeze
# has exactly one explanation. It changes nothing for this manual -- there is nothing here
# for it to keep -- and it is ruled so that the next character no package font covers is
# drawn as a visible box rather than removed.
KEEP_UNCOVERED
PAGES
PAGE_HEIGHT_PT
PAGE_WIDTH_PT
PDF_ITEMS
PDF_WARNINGS
SVG_RASTER_SCALE
